notes: Topline: looking to deflect 60-70% of live chat volume during peak with agent-assist handling the rest.
Traffic profile: ~2M messages/month; peak concurrency ~4k sessions; spikes up to 10k concurrent interactions during promos.
Cost target: want unit economics to hit <$0.0006 per token equivalent (origin calc). very price-sensitive — will trade model fidelity for cost when measurable impact is small.
Tech asks: batching suggestions, prefix KV caching, and quantization profiles (int8/int4) to reduce GPU footprint without dropping F1 on ticket-summarization sets.
Routing: need smart fallback to smaller quantized model under overload; regional routing for NA/EU; prefer pinning major model variants for predictability.
Security: must have SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS integration for keys and 3-year retention on logs for compliance team.
Quote from Head of Ops: 'If you can save us >40% on model cost with parity in CSAT, we can move to reserved capacity.'
POC ask: end-to-end demo with 24h simulated spike, live tool-calling (CRM ticket update via API), and roll-back policy testing.
Procurement note: legal negotiating data residency clause; wants EU residency for EU tenant data.
SE note: concerned about quantization drift on long-form summaries — propose evaluation against 5k labeled tickets, hold quality gates.
